title: Unit Event — The Legend Still Vivid — Episode8 An Even Bigger Hurdle

meta.Event Outline: Thanks to their experience of going camping together, VBS has learned the importance of having a shared vision when they sing. Kohane asks Taiga if there's a way for them to establish a shared vision of RAD WEEKEND without any footage of the event to go off of.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This is what happened during RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (How do I even begin to describe it...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's sent my heart into overdrive... No, more than that...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(It shook the entire world.
It was really that kind of event.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This might be the true definition of “exhilaration”...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It just completely blew apart the way I remembered everything. My heart's still racing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Same...
A part of me was wondering if I was seeing this event through rose-colored glasses...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But it really was just that incredible.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have a much better understanding of what you've all been telling me now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even as a video, it can hit us this hard...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <RAD WEEKEND really was as amazing as everyone was saying...!>

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So, what did you think of RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It exceeded all of my expectations...
I sort of can't believe something like this actually happened...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I feel more excited about this than before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I feel even more determined to surpass RAD WEEKEND now. So...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Way to go, Kohane!!
That's my partner for you!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And you finally got a taste of what I felt that night!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We'll probably have to clear quite a few hurdles and jump through countless hoops to get there...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I believe we can do it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're gonna show everyone who's boss!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(We can do it...
We're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND!!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome back, you two.
You were gone quite a while.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Lay it on me.
What was the venue for RAD WEEKEND like?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It was nice...
The owner seemed to take very good care of it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But something more amazing happened!
Not only did we see the venue, we actually got to see RAD WEEKEND!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We discovered that there was a recording of it, and we even got to watch it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It was... I dunno...
Really, really amazing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Everyone there gave it absolutely everything they had. Almost as if it was the last show they were all doing, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, wait... That's not doing it justice...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I think I understand a little.
It was so incredible that it's too difficult to put into words, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, it was an incredible event...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I have to think RAD WEEKEND has a special place in the hearts of countless people.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Surpassing that means somehow also surpassing what everyone felt that night...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I can't even begin to imagine what that entails...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Think about what you saw...
Focus on what you've absorbed...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(How big was the live house...?
How many people were in the audience...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We came here expecting to see how you've progressed since you started working with Taiga, but to see this kind of change...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's as if you somehow placed yourself in that video.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Do you think actually seeing how everything looked from the stage has anything to do with it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
From the stage?
What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, when I was practicing with Taiga...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, that's what you guys have been doing...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe...
But we're not letting you get away so easily.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mind telling us more about what you've been doing with Uncle Taiga? That's okay, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: While working with him, I learned that...
